rounds.q: What % of US adults have a credit card?
rounds.why: Of card owners, 45% carried a balance at least once in the past year.
rounds.src: Federal Reserve, Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (2025)
rounds.fun: Eight in ten adults have a credit card. Tap, swipe, done.

rounds.q: What % of US adults have a tattoo?
rounds.why: Women are more likely than men to have one, 38% to 27%.
rounds.fun: About one in three adults has some ink. That's a lot of art!

rounds.q: What % of US adults read at least part of a book in the past year?
rounds.why: In the past year, 31% read an e-book and 26% listened to an audiobook.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Book reading survey (2025)
rounds.fun: Three out of four adults opened a book last year. Page turners!

rounds.q: On an average day, what % of Americans (15+) cook or clean up a meal?
rounds.why: That's 72% of women and 58% of men.
rounds.fun: Two out of three people cook or do the dishes on a given day. Chef's kiss!

rounds.q: On an average day, what % of Americans (15+) exercise or play sports?
rounds.why: The people who do it that day spend about an hour and a half at it.
rounds.fun: About one in four people works up a sweat on a given day. Go team!
